system.summary: Symbol cipher; candidate key the Ferdinand-Malvezzi key of 1548 (DECODE R367), not yet tested.
system.notes: R367 (targets/malvezzi1548/k367.txt) has code words for every correspondent here: Vb rex Poloniae, zos Frater Georgius, zes Regina Isabella, zis Joannes Sigismundus, Sis Ibrahim Passa.

prior_solution.where: none found in the repo, AIS descriptions or web search; Austro-Turcica 1541-1552 not seen

conditions.human_role: Opened the catalogue item; reviewed PR #196 and pointed out that the AIS images are reachable without a login.

solution.what: Searched the repo for Martinuzzi, Malvezzi and the AIS ids; found targets/malvezzi1548 and key R367 with code words for all four correspondents.
Read the three AIS records; took the 'Kein Zugang (Reservatbestand)' fields to mean the scans were staff-only and recorded the item as blocked.
Web search for a printed decipherment of the enclosures.

After review: the access fields cover the originals; the scans are public (research/aut_hhsta route, vetting viewed 7-4-4 image 3). Blocked claim withdrawn; wrote fetch_ais.py. The download failed because this session's egress proxy refused the AIS host (and web.archive.org).
Located key R367 (and R386) already transcribed in targets/malvezzi1548/k367.txt, k386.txt; not yet applied for want of a transcription.

outcome.method_basis: In progress: no transcription yet, so the candidate key R367 has not been applied.
outcome.notes: In progress. Scans are public; next session downloads them, transcribes 7-4-4 image 3 and applies R367.
